definitions.explanation: A calculating device consisting of a frame with rods and movable beads, traditionally used for arithmetic calculations.

notes:
Usually written in kana, そろばん. Despite calculators, abacus education remains popular in Japan because it trains mental calculation.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The modern Japanese abacus has one bead above the bar (worth 5) and four beads below it (each worth 1) on every rod; older abacuses had five below. Many children attend after-school abacus classes ({算盤|そろばん}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ or {算盤|そろばん}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧) and take graded proficiency tests.

- ⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧: mental arithmetic, often trained by imagining the abacus
